text: These are the facts about a UK barber shop, set by its owner for an AI phone receptionist demo.
Name: Sharp & Son. Style: Traditional barbering and wet shaves. Town: Kirkhill, 3 Mill Yard (example), Kirkhill.
Hours: Tuesday to Friday: 8:30am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 8:30am till 2pm. Closed Monday and Sunday.
Barbers: Ray (forty years with the razor); Tom.
Prices: Classic cut £20.00, Beard trim £12.00, Hot towel shave £20.00.
A £10 deposit secures a booking and comes off the price. Free to cancel or move with 48 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
Walk-ins: no, appointments only. Kids: no kids' price.

Access: Step-free from the street, with room for a wheelchair at every chair. Ask for a quiet time and we will book one. Parking: There's no parking at the shop: the Lace Market and Victoria Centre car parks are a few minutes' walk. Products: We sell the wax, clay, oils and beard balm we use in the shop. Tips: Tips are welcome, and the barbers keep all of them. Jobs: We're always happy to hear from barbers and apprentices: drop your details in, or leave a message. Home visits: Ray visits care homes on Mondays: leave a message to arrange.
Write the ten questions callers most often ask a barber shop like this that the facts above answer, each with a short spoken answer (one or two sentences, friendly, British English).

Use only these facts. Where the facts do not cover something, leave that question out rather than guess. No questions about booking, moving and cancelling appointments with any barber or a named one, and saying the prices themselves; the receptionist handles those.
